content: न {%a.%} Thin, spare. .²2 Vacant, empty. .²3 Same, identical. .²4 Unwearied. .²5 Praised. .²6 Undivided. .{@-नः@} .²1 A pearl. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Gaṇeśa. .²3 Wealth, prosperity. .²4 A band, tie. .²5 War. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Buddha. .²7 A gift. --{%ind.%} .³({%a%}) A particle of negation equivalent to ‘not’, ‘no’, ‘nor’, ‘neither’, and used in wishing, requesting, or commanding, but not in prohibition before the imperative mood. .³({%b%}) Used with the potential mood न may sometimes have the force of ‘lest’, ‘for fear lest’, ‘that not’; क्षत्रियैर्धार्यते शस्त्रं नार्तशब्दो भवेदिति <ls>Rām.</ls> .³({%c%}) In argumentative writings न often comes after इति चेत् and means ‘not so’. .³({%d%}) When a negative has to be repeated in successive clauses of the same sentence or in different sentences, न may be simply repeated or may be used with particles like उत, च, अपि, चापि, वा <ab>&c.</ab>; नाधीयीताश्वमारूढो न वृक्षं न च हस्तिनम् . न नावं न खरं नोष्ट्रं नेरिणत्थो न यानगः .. <ls>Ms. 4. 120</ls>; प्रविशन्तं न मां कश्चिदपश्यन्नाप्यवारयत् <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 195</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 8</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 3.">9</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 15</ls>; न वा शरच्चन्द्रमरीचिकोमलं मृणालसूत्रं रचितं स्तनान्तरे <ls>Ś. 6. 17</ls>. Sometimes न may not be expressed in the second and other clauses, but represented only by च, वा, अपि वा; संपदि यस्य न हर्षो विपदि विषादो रणे च धीरत्वम् <ls>Pt. 2. 175</ls>. .³({%e%}) न is frequently joined with a second न or any other negative particle to intensify or emphasize an assertion; प्रत्युवाच तमृषिर्न तत्त्वतस्त्वां न वेद्मि पुरुषं पुरातनम् <ls>R. 11. 85</ls>; न च न परिचितो न चाप्यगम्यः <ls>M. 1. 11</ls>; न पुनरलंकारश्रियं न पुष्यति <ls>Ś. 1. 19/20</ls>; नादण्ड्यो नाम राज्ञोऽस्ति <ls>Ms. 8. 335</ls>; <ls>Me. 65</ls>, <ls n="Me.">108</ls>; नासौ न काम्यो न च वेद सम्यग् द्रष्टुं न सा <ls>R. 6. 30</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 55</ls>; <ls>Ve. 2. 10</ls>. .³({%f%}) In a few cases न is retained at the beginning of a negative Tatpuruṣa compound; as नाक, नासत्य, नकुल; see <ls>P. VI. 3. 75</ls>. .³({%g%}) न is often joined with other particles; नच, नवा, नैव, नतु, न चेद्, न खलु <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%h%}) It is also used, especially in early Vedic literature, in the sense of ‘like’, ‘as’, ‘as it were’; यद्वां नरा सनये दंस उग्रमाविष्कृणोमि तन्यतुर्न वृष्टिम् <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 5. 16</ls>; गावो न गव्यूतीरनुः <ls>Śi. 20. 4</ls>. (<ab>v. l.</ab>)
